title: Super STT backend manifest (backend.toml)
description: A backend's declaration of identity: the models it provides, the hosts it may reach, the files those models need, and the secrets/options it requires. The daemon reads it to discover a backend without starting it. See docs/protocol/backend/config.md for the full contract.

allOf.$comment: subprocess backends must declare at least one [[assets.subprocess]]

source.description: Canonical repository id for this backend, e.g. `github.com/<owner>/<repo>`. Becomes the `source` of every model it provides and must be unique across installed backends. For a monorepo, namespace it under the repo (e.g. `github.com/<owner>/<repo>/openai`).

version.description: Backend version (semver). Must match the release tag's version when published through the registry.

kind.description: Selects the transport: `wasm` (a wasm32 component) or `subprocess` (a native executable).

entrypoint.description: Path, relative to the backend directory, to the executable (`subprocess`) or the `.wasm` component (`wasm`). Must be a single safe path component: no `/`, `\`, `.`, or `..`.

contract.description: The backend-protocol contract version implemented. Currently `v1`.

license.description: SPDX license id. Optional for the daemon, but REQUIRED for registry publication — the indexer rejects manifests without an allowlisted license.

description.description: Optional one-line summary shown in the registry/Browse listing.

allowed_hosts.description: Host or `host:port` egress allowlist. Empty or absent means no network. Honored for `wasm` backends; MUST be empty for `subprocess` backends (the transport provides no network).

websocket.description: Opt into the realtime WebSocket import/export. wasm-only: a `subprocess` backend declaring this is rejected at discovery. Required for any model with `realtime = true`. Default `false`.

assets.description: Binary artifacts a release publishes, so the indexer and installer find them without guessing. Shape depends on `[backend].kind`.

wasm.description: Filename on the GitHub release for a wasm backend; must be a `wasm32` component (`.wasm`). Required when `kind = "wasm"`.

subprocess.description: One entry per built variant. Required (non-empty) when `kind = "subprocess"`.

file.description: Filename on the GitHub release (`.tar.gz`). The archive must contain `bin/<entrypoint>`.

target.description: Rust target triple, e.g. `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`. Tier-1/2 only; the indexer rejects unknown triples.

cuda_major.description: CUDA major version this build targets. Required when `accel = "cuda"`, forbidden otherwise.

cuda_sm.description: Compute capability (e.g. 75, 86, 90, 120). Omit to match ANY compute capability — use for multi-architecture framework builds (e.g. a PyTorch wheel). An exact-SM asset is preferred over a wildcard when both match. Forbidden when `accel != "cuda"`.

cudnn.description: Whether this build links cuDNN. Allowed only when `accel = "cuda"`. Default `false`.

name.description: snake_case identifier the backend reads the value by (as the `x-stt-secret-<name>` request header). Unique within the table.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the settings UI. Falls back to `name` when absent.

description.description: Help text shown beside the input in the settings UI.

required.description: Whether a value must be set before the backend can load. Default `false`.

name.description: snake_case identifier the backend reads the value by (as the `x-stt-option-<name>` request header). Unique within the table.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the settings UI. Falls back to `name` when absent.

description.description: Help text shown beside the input in the settings UI.

type.description: Drives the input the UI renders. Default `string`.

default.description: Value used when the user sets none. Should match `type`.

required.description: Whether a value must be set before the backend can load. Default `false`.

name.description: Wire model name. Identified end-to-end by `(name, provider, source)`.

multilingual.description: Whether the model accepts more than one language. Default `true`. When `false`, `supported_languages` must be exactly `[primary_language]`.

primary_language.description: Default language code (e.g. `en`), used when `language` is omitted. Must appear in `supported_languages`.

supported_languages.description: Language codes the model accepts; must include `primary_language`.

supported_devices.description: Devices the model can load onto. `none` is the sentinel for remote/online models and must be the ONLY entry when present (mixing it with a local device is rejected).

estimated_vram_bytes.description: Conservative GPU memory estimate. Default `0`; use `0` for cloud models.

processing_interval_ms.description: Suggested minimum interval between streaming passes, in milliseconds.

realtime.description: When `true`, the model is driven over the consumer WebSocket endpoint rather than batch `POST /v1/transcribe`. Requires `[capabilities] websocket = true`. Default `false`.

files.description: Files the model needs, provisioned into `dest` before `POST /v1/load`. Cloud models declare none.

repo.description: Hugging Face repo id, e.g. `openai/whisper-tiny`. Required when `source = "huggingface"`.

url.description: Direct download URL for a single file. Required when `source = "url"`.

files.description: Filenames to fetch from the repo. Required when `source = "huggingface"`.

dest.description: Directory, relative to the backend dir, to place the files in (e.g. `models/whisper-tiny`).

sha256.description: Optional expected SHA-256 for integrity verification.
